column2: Efile Information

column2: ***The BoB Efile is a conversion of von Adlers 2000 efile and he should take full credit for the work except for the unique units that I added, as follows***

column2: Unique Units
column3: 独有单位

column2: A unit in the infantry class representing a battlefield command post.
column3: 步兵类别中的一个单位，代表战场指挥所。

column2: This is like getting some information from a farmer or the Resistance about enemy positions and strengths which of course is only acurate for a short time hence the 'Fog of War' returns.
column3: 这就像从农民或抵抗组织那里获得一些关于敌军位置和兵力的情报，当然这些情报只在短时间内准确，因此“战争迷雾”会重新出现。

column2: This is a fictional unit with the sole purpose of killing your Intellignce Report unit in 1 hit. It has no movement so can't take any further part in the battle.
column3: 这是一个虚构单位，唯一作用是一击消灭你的情报报告单位。它没有移动力，因此无法再参与战斗。

column2: Come in 2 types Horsa MkII which carries troops only and GA Hamilcar which can carry troops, AT guns, Light Artillery pieces and the Tetrarch light tank. These fly like normal air transports but can land any Airmobile unit anywhere on the map that these units can normally travel.
column3: 有 2 种类型：Horsa MkII 仅运载部队，GA Hamilcar 则可运载部队、反坦克炮、轻型火炮和 Tetrarch 轻型坦克。它们像普通空中运输一样飞行，但可以把任何空中机动单位降落到地图上这些单位通常能行经的任何位置。

column2: A roadblock to holdup the advance of your units for several turns.
column3: 一种路障，用于拖延你的单位推进数个回合。

column2: A unit to destroy the above "Awaiting Orders" and allow the advance of your units at the correct time. It has no movement so can't take any further part in the battle.
column3: 一个用于摧毁上述“等待命令”并让你的单位在正确时机推进的单位。它没有移动力，因此无法再参与战斗。

column2: Come in many forms and differ from their original uniits only in that they cannot move or move only 1 and have 1 point higher Ground Defence. Used to stop the AI or player moving units that in the actual battles were static or over-run.
column3: 有多种形式，与其原版单位的区别仅在于它们不能移动或只能移动 1 格，且地面防御高 1 点。用于阻止 AI 或玩家移动那些在实际战斗中静止不动或被击溃的单位。

column2: German units used in the Bastogne scenarios differ from the units used in other scenarios in that they have a winter cammoflage icon and have reduced fuel to simulate the severe fuel problems the Germans faced near the end of the Battle of the Bulge.
column3: 巴斯托涅(Bastogne)场景中使用的德军单位与其他场景中使用的单位不同，它们有冬季迷彩图标，并降低了燃料，以模拟德军在突出部战役末期面临的严重燃料问题。

column2: A form of ground transport that is used by Infantry units only during the Battle of the Bulge scenarios.
column3: 一种地面运输，仅在突出部战役的场景中由步兵单位使用。

column2: Found at POW camps.
column3: 出现在战俘营。

column2: Well armed men with dogs that patrol near POW camps.
column3: 装备精良、带着狗在战俘营附近巡逻的人员。

column2: Regular paratroop units with very low attack values as they have been captured, disarmed and placed in a POW camp.
column3: 普通的伞兵单位，攻击值非常低，因为他们已被俘、被解除武装并关进战俘营。

column2: Buildings of Hitlers famous mountain retreat.
column3: 希特勒著名山地别墅的建筑。

column2: A 'souvenir' unit that you win the game by capturing.
column3: 一个“纪念品”单位，占领它就能赢得游戏。

column2: Disorganized groups of SS troops fanatically defending the Reich during it's final days.
column3: 在第三帝国最后的日子里狂热防守的、组织混乱的党卫军部队。

column2: The camapign follows the 506th PIR (Parachute Infantry Regiment) so it is largely infantry based with the Artillery and Anti-tank units in the early part being light paradrop units. I used von Adlers efile which I had to change so the player could not buy tanks and planes etc so remember that the upgrade opportunities in the first 8 scenarios is non-existant and they have no transport as the 506th had only what they dropped with for their time in Normandy where they were constantly in action for around 12 days before they were relocated to England for rest and refitting.
column3: 本战役跟随第 506 伞兵团(PIR)，因此主要以步兵为基础，早期的火炮和反坦克单位都是轻型伞降单位。我使用了 von Adlers 的装备文件，并不得不对其加以修改，使玩家无法购买坦克和飞机等，所以请记住，前 8 个场景中不存在升级机会，而且它们没有运输工具，因为第 506 团在诺曼底期间只有随他们一起空降下来的东西，他们在那里连续作战约 12 天后才被调往英格兰休整和整补。
